title: Late night & 24-hour work spots
subtitle: Bangkok cafés open past midnight or around the clock
source: PLUB owner's curated shortlist (first-hand knowledge). Hours can change — confirm on the day.

n11607152639.name: Oasis Coffee Rangnam
n11607152639.work: Strong: two floors, many seats, charging points, garden area; Wi-Fi mixed reviews.

n7058297153.name: Too Fast To Sleep
n7058297153.work: Strong: library-like study/work café, books, coffee, long-running late-night work base.

o216746ef1360.name: Coffee Society
o216746ef1360.work: Good: free Wi-Fi and work seating, power sockets may be limited.

o37431e975784.name: Glur Bangkok
o37431e975784.area: Charoen Krung Soi 50, near BTS Saphan Taksin
o37431e975784.work: Casual: café-bar-hostel hybrid; better for late-night socializing than quiet deep work.

od29ff046f20a.name: Think Tank
od29ff046f20a.work: Good: co-working café with walk-in access; private rooms for groups (fee).

w332011985.name: FABLAB Cafe & Dining
w332011985.work: Evening work; check noise levels and socket availability.

n2074232887.name: Tom N Toms Coffee
n2074232887.work: Good: two floors, substantial seating, wall sockets; useful after midnight.

n3479102803.name: Hollys Coffee
n3479102803.area: Sukhumvit 15, Siam Kit, The Street Ratchada (selected branches)
n3479102803.work: Good for standard café work; check exact branch.

n10080517094.name: Starbucks
n10080517094.work: Reliable, familiar; branch-specific seating, noise, Wi-Fi vary.

w943263643.name: Let's Say Café
w943263643.work: Strong: popular with students and remote workers; multi-floor, board games, relaxed work/study atmosphere.

n6142506085.name: Future Cafe and Restaurant
n6142506085.work: Good late-night choice; verify seating and Wi-Fi on arrival.

n12317637826.name: Paper Plane Project
n12317637826.work: Strong: co-working space, café, and bar; free working Wi-Fi, communal tables by day, bar after dark.

n4688643102.name: Korean Dessert Cafe
n4688643102.work: Casual: better for meetings, dessert-and-coffee than deep work.

n4865439625.name: Iwane Goes Nature
n4865439625.work: Good: specialty-coffee environment with midnight cutoff.

n11661600206.name: E-motion
n11661600206.work: Late-night coffee option in Sukhumvit corridor.

n13184508798.name: The Trade Cafe
n13184508798.work: Another midnight-close option outside the central core.

w626686392.name: Arelomdee
w626686392.work: Good for an evening work session in the old town.

notInCatalogue.name: Fu.5 Coffee
notInCatalogue.work: Good: power-socket zone and meeting room; community-oriented atmosphere.
notInCatalogue.note: Not yet in the open-map catalogue; add via OpenStreetMap note.

notInCatalogue.name: 24 Owls
notInCatalogue.work: Good: café, restaurant, co-working community; indoor and outdoor laptop seating.
notInCatalogue.note: Not yet in the open-map catalogue; add via OpenStreetMap note.

notInCatalogue.name: Baan Rai Coffee
notInCatalogue.work: Mixed: second floor quieter, but live music and beer garden less ideal for focused work.
notInCatalogue.note: Not yet in the open-map catalogue; add via OpenStreetMap note.
